# Real transcript MACHINERY strings — text that arrives in a user-role slot but
# was authored by the harness, not typed by the human.
#
# tests/test_history_privacy.py asserts that history/machinery.py classifies
# EVERY line here as machinery. That is the completeness check on the enumerated
# part of the filter: when a new machinery string is observed in the wild, add it
# here FIRST — if the filter does not already cover it by shape, the test fails
# until the filter is extended. A hand-written list with no fixture behind it is
# what let the compaction preamble through in the first place.
#
# One string per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# Long strings may be truncated to the part that identifies them.

# --- slash-command expansion / local command output (Claude Code) ---
<command-name>/model</command-name>
<command-message>model</command-message>
<command-args>opus</command-args>
<local-command-stdout>Set model to Opus 5</local-command-stdout>
<local-command-stderr>command not found: nh</local-command-stderr>
<local-command-caveat>Local commands were run</local-command-caveat>
<command-stdout>ok</command-stdout>
<command-stderr>failed</command-stderr>

# --- bash tool plumbing ---
<bash-input>git status</bash-input>
<bash-stdout>On branch main</bash-stdout>
<bash-stderr>fatal: not a git repository</bash-stderr>

# --- harness-injected reminders and tool blocks ---
<system-reminder>As you answer the user's questions, you can use the following context</system-reminder>
<function_calls>
<function_results>
<tool_use_error>File has not been read yet.</tool_use_error>

# --- the caveat preamble ---

# --- compaction / summary machinery (the string that shipped the defect) ---
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context.
The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation. Please continue the conversation from where we left it off without asking the user any further questions.
Please continue the conversation from where we left it off without asking the user any further questions. You MUST continue from where you left off.
Your task is to create a detailed summary of the conversation so far, paying close attention to the user's explicit requests and your previous actions.
